semiconductor_relevance: High — U.K. Technology Corp. specializes in advanced manufacturing equipment and processes for LCD and next-generation electronic components, which are integral to semiconductor production.
summary: U.K. Technology Corporation provides advanced manufacturing equipment and solutions for the LCD industry and next-generation electronic components. Their offerings include inspection systems, wafer measurement technologies, and specialized processing equipment, aimed at enhancing production efficiency and precision in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Intelligent Automated Confocal Wafer Thickness Measurement System

regional_presence.China: The company has expanded its market presence in China and established a branch office in Dong Guan in 1999.
